freeze_blocker: Numerical values below have no written justifications. A draft commit is not a freeze and not an independent time anchor. Push availability is unverified until a write succeeds or fails.
arm_c_unavailability_clause: Arm C requires earlier-only out-of-fold forecasts from Arm A. If comparable OOF A forecasts cannot be recovered, Arm C is unavailable. Because B-C is the primary contrast in the fixed-sequence family, the entire confirmatory family is blocked; B-A is then a descriptive comparison only. Any confirmatory use of B-A requires a new registration with a new primary contrast. The pilot's paired B-C losses require the same OOF A forecasts, so the pilot fails for the same reason.
sequencing: 1. Recoverability check of earlier-only OOF A forecasts; if it fails, record the blocker and stop.
2. Write justifications for every value below.
3. Freeze final values and push; anchor via GitHub push/PR time, a tag created at push, or an independently posted commit hash. Author date is not an anchor.
4. Only after the anchor exists: build pilot runner, run pilot, compute dependence diagnostics.
5. Apply the frozen rule; plan sample size.
6. At registration: re-query main head, record SHA and UTC time, write registration block as a successor commit.

pilot_decision_rule.pilot_data_requirement: Earlier-only chronological data, disjoint from confirmation data and from the 13 Nov 27 discovery fixtures.

diagnostics.lag1_autocorrelation: Lag-1 autocorrelation of the weekly mean paired B-C CRPS difference, computed within season and pooled across pilot seasons, reported with an uncertainty interval.
diagnostics.design_effect: variance of weekly means divided by (within-week variance divided by games in that week)

minimum_pooled_weekly_means.note: Derive from a target standard error for the lag-1 estimate. A single 14-week season gives a standard error near 0.27, so pooling many pilot seasons is required.

thresholds.low_dependence: lag1 < lag1 cutoff AND design effect < design-effect cutoff
thresholds.high_dependence: lag1 >= lag1 cutoff OR design effect >= design-effect cutoff

estimator_rule.if_low_dependence: week-level clustering or wild cluster bootstrap; four-week block bootstrap not required
estimator_rule.if_diagnostics_insufficient: blocked; extend pilot; do not choose an estimator

season_count_rule.method: Coverage simulation using pilot-derived paired differences at each candidate block count.
season_count_rule.criterion: Smallest block count at which the one-sided bound attains at least the minimum simulated coverage.
season_count_rule.if_not_achieved: blocked; extend pilot or register a longer confirmation window

effect_size_parameters.freeze_timing: frozen together with this addendum, before the pilot

proposed_minimum_useful_improvement_crps.justification: pending_justification: state why this is the smallest improvement that matters
